{{Top|leg}}
'''Lynn Skims''' was the former owner of a small family-operated textiles business on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. She sold the business after the loss of her husband, [[Doyle Skims|Doyle]], with whom she had two children, [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] operatives [[Athon Skims|Athon]] and [[Lyda Skims|Lyda]]. Doyle was a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Death/Legends|killed]] during the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].
